title: Targeted primary-source research packet B: Indian electrolyzer and hydrogen equipment capability

scope.source_policy: Official primary/company, government, government-institution, and standards sources only; no secondary sources used. Reduced to the eight strongest bounded records.
tasks: Operating Indian electrolyzer stack manufacturing facilities with explicitly reported nameplate/status
Domestic MEA, membrane, catalyst-coated-electrode, or closely scoped electrolyzer-component production/qualification
Operating Indian hydrogen purification or gas-handling equipment manufacturing facilities
Official Indian testing, standards, and qualification infrastructure for electrolyzers

method.evidence_unit: One bounded source record with source-local scope and explicit capacity semantics.
method.epistemic_rule: REPORTED claims remain REPORTED; institutional tests remain institution-reported; no inference of effective, qualified, available, utilized, yield-adjusted, or allocated capacity.
method.temporal_rule: Preserve publication/report date and retrieval date; do not arithmetically merge dated capacity/status statements.
method.canonical_rule: Reference-only staging candidates; no canonical edits, fuzzy merges, shadow identities, or promotions.

source_ledger.title: Energy Projects Segment, Integrated Annual Report 2024-25

source_ledger.claim: L&T reports 400 MW annual electrolyser capacity set up at Hazira, dispatch of its first indigenous electrolyser, and a commissioned robotic stack line.

capacity.qualifier: company-reported annual manufacturing capacity set up

tasks.question: Operating Indian electrolyzer stack manufacturing facilities and explicit nameplate/status
tasks.bounded_result: L&T reports a commissioned first indigenous system and later reports 400 MW/year set up plus a commissioned robotic stack line at Hazira. Ohmium reports an officially launched Doddaballapura PEM factory ramping up to ship 2 GW factory scale. Neither record proves realized annual output, utilization, yield, or qualified available capacity.
explicit_unknowns: Ohmium current nameplate period and realized output
Both facilities' yield, utilization, and project allocation

tasks.question: Domestic MEA, membrane, catalyst-coated-electrode, and closely scoped electrolyzer-component production/qualification
tasks.bounded_result: ARCI reports indigenous MEA/bipolar-plate fabrication in a 5 kg/day ECMR demonstration and lists MEA/CCM/electrode process know-how for licensing. BARC reports an alkaline-electrolyser membrane diaphragm tested to 500 mm and specifies casting infrastructure. No source establishes commercial component nameplate or independent product certification.

tasks.question: Operating Indian hydrogen purification and gas-handling equipment manufacturing facilities
tasks.bounded_result: INOXCVA reports Indian manufacture of hydrogen cryogenic storage/transport/distribution and fluid-servicing equipment. Thermax reports 12 Indian manufacturing facilities and a current hydrogen/oxygen purification offering. The bounded pages do not map hydrogen products to a named plant or report qualified throughput.
explicit_unknowns: Named hydrogen-equipment plant and nameplate for INOXCVA
Named hydrogen-purification plant and capacity for Thermax
Qualification, utilization, and effective available supply

tasks.question: Official Indian testing, standards, and qualification infrastructure for electrolyzers
tasks.bounded_result: NISE reports a hydrogen demonstration station with an additional 10 Nm3/hr electrolyzer being integrated and publishes an official electrolyzer test menu/lab scheme. BIS lists IS 16509:2020 for water-electrolysis hydrogen generators. These establish demonstration, scheme, and standards layers, not universal lab accreditation or manufacturer qualification.
explicit_unknowns: Current accredited laboratory roster and NABL scope
External test availability and acceptance authority
